proof_body:
by
  intro X _ _ _ T m K _ hK0 hK1 h
  have hc : ContractingWith K.toNNReal (T^[m]) := by
    refine ⟨by simpa using hK1, LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun u v => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal K hK0]
    exact h u v
  have hp : Function.IsFixedPt (T^[m]) (hc.fixedPoint) := hc.fixedPoint_isFixedPt
  have hT : Function.IsFixedPt (T^[m]) (T hc.fixedPoint) := by
    show T^[m] (T hc.fixedPoint) = T hc.fixedPoint
    rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply', hp]
  refine ⟨hc.fixedPoint, hc.fixedPoint_unique hT, fun b hb => ?_⟩
  exact hc.fixedPoint_unique (Function.iterate_fixed hb m)
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] [Nonempty X] (T : X → X) (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ), 0 < m → 0 ≤ K → K < 1 → (∀ u v, dist (T^[m] u) (T^[m] v) ≤ K * dist u v) → ∃ a : X, T a = a ∧ ∀ b, T b = b → b = a
